methodologyNotes: Prices fetched from official vendor pricing/product pages where available. Bark prices from bark.us/pricing and bark.us/bark-app (USD prices rendered live, June 2026). Qustodio's official site (qustodio.com/en/premium/) geolocated to EUR; USD plan prices sourced from TechRadar review (last updated July 2025) and cross-checked against TechRadar review article for plan structure — noted in provenance. Norton Family from us.norton.com/products/norton-family-premier (USD prices live). Aura from aura.com/pricing and aura.com/parental-controls (USD prices live). Mobicip from mobicip.com/pricing (USD prices live, billed annually). CleanBrowsing from cleanbrowsing.org/pricing (USD prices live). Circle (meetcircle.com) now redirects to Aura — Circle is excluded as a separate entity since it merged into Aura. All monthlyUsd figures for annually-billed plans represent the annualized monthly rate. accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources.

vendors.name: Bark
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page bark.us/pricing and product page bark.us/bark-app fetched 2026-06-14; USD prices rendered live.

plans.name: Bark Jr
plans.notes: Annual price $49/yr ($4.08/mo). Covers unlimited devices and children. Includes screen time management, website filtering, location alerts/check-ins, and basic monitoring of texts/email/30+ apps. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Bark Premium (Android)
plans.notes: Annual price $99/yr ($8.25/mo). Covers unlimited devices and children. Full monitoring of texts, email, YouTube, and 30+ social/app platforms; AI-driven alerts for cyberbullying, predators, and mental health concerns; GPS tracking; screen time; app/website blocking. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Bark Premium (iOS)
plans.notes: Annual price $148/yr ($12.33/mo). Higher price includes the Bark Sync smart charger hardware (required due to Apple privacy restrictions — device must be plugged in to scan). Same monitoring features as Android Premium. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Bark Home
plans.notes: Router-based home network parental controls. $6/mo subscription OR $79 one-time device purchase (no monthly fee). Covers all home devices (smart TVs, gaming consoles, tablets, computers). 30-day money-back guarantee.

vendors.name: Qustodio
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page qustodio.com/en/premium/ fetched 2026-06-14 but geolocated to EUR — no USD figures displayed. USD prices sourced from TechRadar review (www.techradar.com/reviews/qustodio, last updated July 2025) as reputable 2025 comparison source. Plan structure (Free/Basic/Complete) corroborated by official page EUR tiers.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 device only. Includes web filtering, daily time limits, 7-day activity reports, and internet pause. No credit card required.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Billed annually at $54.95/yr ($4.58/mo). Up to 5 devices. Includes games/app blocking, daily time limits, web filtering, location monitoring, internet pause, AI-powered alerts, social monitoring, gaming alerts. No monthly billing option published. 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Complete
plans.notes: Billed annually at $99.95/yr ($8.33/mo). Unlimited devices. Adds YouTube monitoring, 30-day activity reports, custom app/website rules, calls & messages monitoring, priority email support. 30-day money-back guarantee.

vendors.name: Norton Family
vendors.provenance: Official product page us.norton.com/products/norton-family-premier fetched 2026-06-14; USD price $49.99/yr rendered live. Renewal rate displayed as placeholder '{msrp}/year' — exact renewal amount not disclosed on page.

plans.name: Norton Family
plans.notes: Annual-only billing at $49.99/yr for the first year ($4.17/mo). Renewal price higher but not disclosed on page (shown as placeholder). Unlimited devices, unlimited children. Covers web supervision, time limits, location tracking, search filtering, app supervision. 60-day money-back guarantee.

vendors.name: Aura
vendors.provenance: Official pricing pages aura.com/pricing and aura.com/parental-controls fetched 2026-06-14; USD prices rendered live. Note: Circle parental controls (meetcircle.com) was acquired by Aura and redirects to Aura — not tracked separately.

plans.name: Kids
plans.notes: Annual billing: $10/mo ($120/yr), saving ~23%. Monthly billing: $13/mo. Parental controls only (no identity theft protection). Unlimited kids, unlimited devices. Includes content filtering, screen time limits, internet pause, usage reports, cyberbullying alerts. 14-day free trial; 60-day money-back guarantee on annual plans.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Annual billing: $12/mo ($144/yr), saving ~20%. Monthly: $15/mo. 1 adult, 10 devices. Identity theft protection + VPN + antivirus + password manager. Includes parental controls for children's devices. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Couple
plans.notes: Annual billing: $22/mo ($264/yr), saving ~24%. Monthly: $29/mo. 2 adults, 20 devices. Full identity protection suite plus parental controls. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Annual billing: $32/mo ($384/yr), saving ~36%. Monthly: $50/mo. 5 adults, unlimited kids, unlimited devices. Full identity theft protection, $5M insurance coverage, credit monitoring, antivirus, VPN, password manager, and parental controls. 14-day free trial; 60-day money-back on annual.

vendors.name: Mobicip
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page mobicip.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14; USD prices rendered live. All plans billed annually only through the website.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: Billed annually at $35.88/yr ($2.99/mo). Up to 5 devices. Includes app blocker, website blocker, screen time limits, managed schedules, family locator, activity reports, social media monitor. 7-day free trial; 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually at $59.88/yr ($4.99/mo). Up to 10 devices. All Lite features plus same feature set, higher device limit. 7-day free trial; 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually at $95.88/yr ($7.99/mo). Up to 20 devices. Labeled 'Best Value'. Same features as Standard with highest device limit for families. Organizations needing 20+ devices directed to custom quote. 7-day free trial; 30-day money-back guarantee.

vendors.name: CleanBrowsing
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page cleanbrowsing.org/pricing fetched 2026-06-14; USD prices rendered live. Service targets families, schools, libraries, and organizations — DNS-level filtering with parental control focus.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Monthly: $8.99/mo. Annual: $75/yr ($6.25/mo), ~30% discount. Up to 25 devices, up to 3.75M DNS requests/month. 3 filtering profiles. For families. DNS-based content filtering — no software agent required.

plans.name: Pro 50
plans.notes: Monthly: $15/mo. Annual: $150/yr ($12.50/mo), ~17% discount. Up to 50 devices, up to 7.5M DNS requests/month. 5 filtering profiles. Targeted at schools and libraries.

plans.name: Pro 100
plans.notes: Monthly: $30/mo. Annual: $300/yr ($25/mo), ~17% discount. Up to 100 devices, up to 15M DNS requests/month. 10 filtering profiles. Includes API access. For organizations.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: For organizations needing 15M+ DNS requests/month or 100+ devices. Contact sales@cleanbrowsing.org for quote.

vendors.name: Screen Time (Screentimelabs)
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page screentimelabs.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14; Free plan and Premium monthly price ($6.99/mo) confirmed live. Annual and 6-month prices not disclosed on the pricing page — only noted as available options; those prices could not be verified and are omitted.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free forever. 1 device per child. Monitoring only: app usage tracking, daily reports, web history (Android), social media monitoring (Android), YouTube history (Android).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Monthly: $6.99/mo. Annual and 6-month billing options exist but prices not published on page. Up to 5 devices per account, unlimited children. Adds daily time limits, app blocking, tasks/chores, instant pause, web filtering, geofencing, GPS location tracking. 7-day free trial (no credit card required).
